newsitem.title: UK: UK's Secure Retirement directors resign.
newsitem.headline: UK's Secure Retirement directors resign.

text.p: Secure Retirement Plc said on Tuesday that two directors, Blake Gorst and Alan Savery, resigned from the board at a meeting on Monday.
The property development company gave no further details.

Earlier Secure, a residential property development to personalised care group, said it has made an agreed offer for English Premiership soccer club Southampton Football Club Ltd for 10.01 million pounds.
The deal, which is recommended by Southampton directors, would give the club increased access to funding together with a strengthened management team, Secure said in a statement.
Secure, chaired by Rupert Lowe, will rename itself Southampton Leisure Holdings Plc and plans to move the club's stadium to a 73-acre site in the north of Southampton, on the English south coast.
Secure, trading in whose shares was suspended pending approval of the deal by shareholders, is offering 320 new Secure shares for every one Southampton share.
